exec: A prosecution over a high-profile leak of unreleased game footage has reached a guilty plea.
plain: A teenager pleaded guilty in a UK court over the leak of early footage from the video game Grand Theft Auto VI. Only the headline is available so far.
summary: A teenager pleaded guilty in a UK court over the leak of early footage from the video game Grand Theft Auto VI, The Record reported. Only the headline has been read so far, so details of the charges and sentencing are not captured.
title: Teen hacker pleads guilty in UK over Grand Theft Auto VI footage leak
